record.question: Hobson's choice
record.explanation: Answer B: no choice at all. Hobson’s choice means there is only one thing one can take or do, so B is the closest option. Independent check: Hobson’s choice means having no real choice, only one option. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hobson-s-choice. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
